description: Full-text search across every page on momenticmarketing.com (blog posts, research, the Google update tracker with each update's status and dates, case studies, Content Academy guides, Atlas, team pages, careers, the SEO news feed item by item, and Momentic's agent tools and skills), including pages published since Webflow's sitemap was last rebuilt. Returns up to 10 pages ranked by relevance (newest first when the query asks for the latest, newest or most recent; tracker pages by the date Google announced the update), each with its URL, title, content type, published date, author and the passage that best matches the query. Read a full page with get_page.

format.description: Optional: json returns structured results (url, title, type, date, author, image, passage; tracker pages also tracker: status, announced, started, completed, kind).

recent.description: Optional: newest first among relevant pages (also implied by words like latest, newest, most recent in the query). Tracker pages sort by the date Google announced the update.

type.description: Optional: only pages of this content type.

name: search
